use default

mod_pow(base: bigint, exponent: bigint, modulus: bigint) -> bigint is
    let result mut = 1n
    let b mut = base % modulus
    let e mut = exponent

    while e > 0n do
        if e % 2n =~ 1n then
            result = (result * b) % modulus
        fi

        e = e / 2n
        b = (b * b) % modulus
    od

    result
si

is_probable_prime(n: bigint) -> bool is
    if n < 2n then
        return false
    fi

    if n =~ 2n \/ n =~ 3n then
        return true
    fi

    if n % 2n =~ 0n then
        return false
    fi

    let d mut = n - 1n
    let r mut = 0

    while d % 2n =~ 0n do
        d = d / 2n
        r = r + 1
    od

    let witnesses = [2n, 3n, 5n, 7n, 11n, 13n, 17n, 19n, 23n, 29n, 31n, 37n]

    witnesses
        |> filter(a => a < n)
        |> all(a => (
            let x mut = mod_pow(a, d, n)

            if x =~ 1n \/ x =~ n - 1n then
                true
            else
                let found mut = false
                let i mut = 0

                while i < r - 1 /\ !found do
                    x = (x * x) % n

                    if x =~ n - 1n then
                        found = true
                    fi

                    i = i + 1
                od

                found
            fi
        ))
si

factorial_primes() -> Ghul.Pipes.Pipe[(n: int, sign: int, value: bigint)] is
    let fact mut = 1n
    let n mut = 1

    do
        fact = fact * cast bigint(n)

        if is_probable_prime(fact - 1n) then
            yield (n = n, sign = -1, value = fact - 1n)
        fi

        if is_probable_prime(fact + 1n) then
            yield (n = n, sign = 1, value = fact + 1n)
        fi

        n = n + 1
    od
si

for entry in factorial_primes() |> take(10) do
    let op = if entry.sign < 0 then "-" else "+" fi

    write_line("{entry.n}! {op} 1 = {entry.value}")
od
